plugins.name: sdlc-core
plugins.description: The process layer: 4 agents (plan/developer/verify/review) plus shared skills for evidence discipline, output contracts, arbitration, vendoring provenance, secret scanning, walkthroughs, and world-class UI/UX design and audit for both web and mobile.

plugins.name: react-sdlc
plugins.description: Scaffold, vertical-slice, gate, and release skills for React + Vite + TypeScript. Generalized greenfield and adopt-in-place version-selection profiles, feature-based architecture with enforced import boundaries, and best-in-market state and routing patterns.

plugins.name: flutter-sdlc
plugins.description: Scaffold, vertical-slice, gate, and release skills for Flutter. flutter_bloc with Cubit as the settled state-management choice, Service/Repository/Cubit/Screen layering with sealed Result and state types, and a strict-analysis gate.

plugins.name: schema-architect
plugins.description: Model, emit, audit, and promote skills for Oracle schema design. Parameterized naming, audit-column, soft-delete, and migration-versioning conventions grounded in current industry practice rather than any single project's choices.

plugins.name: api-architect
plugins.description: Contract, emit-handler, audit, and publish skills for REST APIs. Stack-neutral rules (real HTTP status codes, RFC 9457 problem+json, resource-oriented verbs, cursor pagination, bearer auth, idempotency, optimistic concurrency) with Oracle ORDS as the worked implementation.
